init.title: Notifications and engine hours
init.description:
Native push notifications in the Home Assistant app about new "due soon/overdue" items (service and insurance): enter your notify service, e.g. mobile_app_your_phone (empty - off).

Engine hours: for equipment counted in engine hours pick a "running" entity (on - the equipment runs, e.g. the generator binary_sensor) - PitUp will count the running time itself: the base is the current value in PitUp, it writes every 15 min while running and right after it stops. Empty - not counted. The generator-motohours.yaml package is then not needed (disable it to avoid counting twice).
